svg.text: X = cymbals (hi-hat and crash). Round dots = drums. Numbers under each bar are the counts: 1 & 2 & 3 & 4 &.
C Drive beat (kick on every beat)
Tip: in section C the hi-hat is played with the stick on the beat (X) and opened on the “and” (X with a little o). In a FILL you play snare, snare, tom, floor tom.
